# oidn-webgpu

> Open Image Denoise (OIDN) on WebGPU: GPU denoising of path-traced images in browsers (npm package `oidn-webgpu`) and natively through wgpu (experimental Rust and C APIs). One TypeScript core plans the same WGSL kernels for every runtime.

- Browser entry points: `initUNetFromURL(url, { device }?, options?)` or `initUNetFromBuffer(...)`, then `unet.tileExecute({ color, albedo?, normal?, done, progress?, error? })`, which returns an abort function.
- Weights (`.tza`) are not bundled. Choose them by inputs: `rt_ldr*` or `rt_hdr*`; `_alb_nrm` / `_calb_cnrm` add albedo + normal; `_small` / `_large` trade speed for quality.
- Normals: browser inputs are [0, 1]-encoded (`n * 0.5 + 0.5`); native inputs are signed [-1, 1], like OIDN.
- Native APIs are experimental; the native guide records tested GPU configurations and output validation. Rust hosts must use wgpu `=30.0.1`. Registry crates bundle platform cores; the manual native release workflow publishes GitHub Release assets and the crate after all checks.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/README.md): overview, runtimes, browser quick start, weights table
- [Browser guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/docs/web.md): options, input formats, `tileExecute` contract, GPU pipelines, tiling, precision, profiling
- [Native guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/native/README.md): Rust `Denoiser`, CPU C filter and GPU C Metal APIs, standalone Cargo application, image contract, precompiled packages, CMake targets, build configuration
- [Development guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/docs/development.md): architecture, shared core vs. browser-only code, commands, benchmarks, native Metal profiling, CI
- [Native release guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/docs/native-release.md): versioned core assets, independently buildable crates, manual publication, Trusted Publishing and retries
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/AGENTS.md): repository map and rules for changing the code

## API sources

- [src/main.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/src/main.ts): public exports and `UNetOptions`
- [src/UNet.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/src/UNet.ts): `UNet`, `tileExecute`, `prepareForImage`, profiling
- [native/src/denoiser.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/native/src/denoiser.rs): Rust `Model`, `Denoiser`, `PreparedDenoise`, `Error`
- [native/include/oidn_webgpu.h](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/native/include/oidn_webgpu.h): C filter API and its contracts
- [native/include/oidn_webgpu_gpu.h](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/native/include/oidn_webgpu_gpu.h): GPU C handles, submissions, completion and lifetime contracts
- [native/include/oidn_webgpu_metal.h](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/native/include/oidn_webgpu_metal.h): Metal device, buffer and shared-event import

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pissang/oidn-webgpu/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes and migration steps
